note: A regional study of national identity systems. On Burundi it says the national ID has since 1980 been a paper card issued by the police under the interior ministry, with no unique number and no central electronic database, and that Burundi alone of the six states had not used biometrics and AFIS for ID issuance (2017). That is the civil identity card, not a police record or police identification system; nothing on station records.
